sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the requirement: applicability is scoped to sea ice, integer winter growth count <= 1, and inclusive 0.3–2.0 m thickness; the violation filter correctly rejects both a missing firstYearIce value and any non-first-year classification, while preserving the supplied ship owners, paths, datatypes, and metre unit.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conclusion check: under the applicability conditions, require iceTypeClassification to have the exact controlled value nltl:firstYearIce, and ensure a present non-first-year classification cannot pass. The current FILTER NOT EXISTS only detects absence of firstYearIce, so a wrong classification satisfies the constraint accidentally. Preserve the prior repair instruction: replace the conclusion check with an explicit exact-value check for nltl:iceTypeClassification. Preserve the prior exact-value repair: under the applicable case, iceTypeClassification must be present and exactly nltl:firstYearIce, with any non-first-year value causing failure. Also move winterGrowthCount and iceThickness range constraints out of the unconditional ship properties and scope them to the implication's applicability; otherwise ships outside the sea-ice, <=1 winter-growth, 0.3–2.0 m conditions fail. Keep the supplied ship target, owner paths, seaIceOrigin condition, integer bound, and inclusive metre range unchanged.

The candidate faithfully encodes the requirement: applicability is scoped to sea ice, integer winter growth count <= 1, and inclusive 0.3–2.0 m thickness; the violation filter correctly rejects both a missing firstYearIce value and any non-first-year classification, while preserving the supplied ship owners, paths, datatypes, and metre unit.
